description: The Special Cargo Operations Coordinator performs end-to-end advanced functions for special cargo (fragile goods, hazardous materials, oversized freight, perishable goods, high-value items), from reservations to transport and handling coordination and necessary support. He/ she will ensure that special cargoes are transported safely, efficiently, and in compliance with regulations. He/ she will work under the supervision of a DG specialist.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Track and coordinate the transit of special cargo
Manage special cargo movement through various modes of transport
Resolve exceptions during special cargo operations
Ensure regulatory compliance and Risk Management
Follow health safety and security procedures in the cargo operational area
